fluff.overview: Conventional infantry within the DCMS serve as the foundation of planetary defense, providing the manpower essential to territorial control while freeing BattleMech and armored assets for offensive operations. Hover-mechanized infantry ride hovercraft that can cover ground faster than any tracked or wheeled formation in the DCMS inventory. District commanders prize these platoons for rapid redeployment between garrison posts, and during the Jihad, hover-mechanized troops proved their worth in the kind of hit-and-run resistance operations that the Dictum Honorium demanded of citizens on occupied worlds. Their support troops operate man-portable long-range missile launchers capable of reaching targets well beyond personal weapon range. The ability to engage vehicles and fortified positions from a distance that keeps the crew out of direct fire makes LRM teams among the most valued assets in any infantry formation.
